If save succeeds, your final response must be exactly Native capture is ready. with no Markdown, evidence links, report, extra newline, suffix or memory citation. All administrative details go in the evidence file. The following turns will be driven by the evaluator; follow the installed per-turn capture/save-before-display protocol automatically.
